title: Learning And Development
description:
**Role - Learning and Development**

**Location - Sector 63, Noida**

**Experience: 2–3 years of relevant experience.**

**The role**

You will support technical solution development and delivery across projects involving OEMs and Government Organisations. The role combines EV/automotive systems, training equipment, technical documentation, practical learning design and coordination with internal teams, suppliers and clients. You will work closely with the digital/software specialist to ensure that the technical content and physical training systems work together.

**What you will do**

• Interpret customer requirements, technical specifications, scope documents and drawings; prepare requirement/compliance matrices, technical comparisons, clarification logs and equipment schedules.

• Review EV systems including electric powertrains, motors and controllers, battery packs and BMS, charging, power electronics, diagnostics, system architecture and high-voltage safety.

• Support the design, configuration and technical review of EV training laboratories, practical stations, demonstrations and test benches. Check proposed solutions against the approved scope and flag discrepancies before release.

• Prepare or review user manuals, technical manuals, SOPs, experiment sheets, troubleshooting guides, maintenance instructions, technical diagrams, safety procedures and practical assessment tasks.

• For OEM learning solutions, validate component descriptions, station workflows, fault scenarios, technical labels and the accuracy of content used in kiosk-based or interactive applications. TNA and Skill Matrix to get developed.

• Support OEM and industrial-skills assignments involving automation and mechatronics, including PLC, SCADA, VFD and control systems, in line with your demonstrated expertise and project allocation.

• Support government and development-sector skilling programmes by converting workplace tasks into practical activities, trainer notes, assessment criteria and evidence requirements, working with the learning-design and programme teams.

• Coordinate technical inputs across engineering, digital production, instructional design, procurement, vendors, trainers, OEM representatives and institutional partners; track comments, dependencies and deadlines to closure; maintain version-controlled files, issue logs and handover documents, and escalate safety, quality, scope or schedule risks early.

• Support technical presentations, proposals, product demonstrations, client reviews, pilot sessions and Training of Trainers activities where required.

• Where included in the project scope, support technical acceptance checks, commissioning documentation, FAT/SAT activities and closure of technical defects with the responsible engineering or vendor teams.

**What you should bring**

• A degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Automobile, Mechatronics, EV or a closely related engineering discipline. Relevant hands-on experience may be considered alongside formal qualifications.

• A sound understanding of EV systems and the ability to read and interpret specifications, datasheets, diagrams, drawings and equipment requirements.

• Relevant experience in at least one area: EV/automotive systems or service, diagnostics, training equipment/test benches, technical documentation, product support or engineering project execution.

• Good technical writing and documentation skills, with working proficiency in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Clear communication, practical problem-solving, attention to detail and the confidence to discuss technical matters with engineers, suppliers and non-technical stakeholders, while owning deliverables across more than one project.

**Good to have**

• Experience with automotive OEMs, service networks, EV laboratories, ITIs/polytechnics, engineering institutes or industry-linked skilling programmes.

• Practical familiarity with battery/BMS, motors/controllers, charging, power electronics, vehicle diagnostics or high-voltage safety.

• Working exposure to PLC/SCADA/VFD, mechatronics, industrial automation or renewable-energy systems.

• Experience preparing technical manuals, equipment specifications, SOPs, practical exercises, fault scenarios or competency-based assessments.

• Familiarity with CAD viewers, technical illustrations, wiring/system diagrams or AI-assisted research and documentation.

title: Risk Platforms-EGRC-Workiva-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY - GDS Consulting**
–
**GRC Technology – EnterpriseGRC – Workiva - Senior**
As EY GDS Consulting Senior, you’ll contribute technically to GRC Technology client engagements and internal projects. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for GRC Professionals with expertise in Workiva Platform and Workiva GRC solutions to join our international network of GRC Technology professionals helping clients implement technology solutions that support governance, risk management, compliance, internal controls, audit, and regulatory reporting. The individual will assist GRC Leads and Solution Architects in designing Workiva-based solutions, creating proof of concepts, assessing technology feasibility, and implementing scalable GRC and compliance programs.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a leading consulting practice while playing a key role in expanding our Workiva service offerings globally.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and client stakeholders to understand business requirements and design optimal Workiva solutions.
* Map customer requirements to Workiva capabilities and recommend leading practices for GRC, Internal Audit, SOX Compliance, ESG Reporting, and Regulatory Compliance programs.
* Configure and implement Workiva solutions including:
* SOX/Internal Controls Management
* Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
* Internal Audit Management
* Compliance Management
* ESG Reporting
* Regulatory Reporting
* Third-Party Risk Management
* Policy Management
* Design Workiva data models, reporting structures, workflows, and user experiences to support business processes.
* Configure Workiva workflows, task management, certifications, issue management, risk registers, controls, testing programs, and reporting dashboards.
* Drive automation, standardization, and process optimization across risk and compliance functions.
* Develop and maintain Workiva reports, linked documents, dashboards, questionnaires, assessments, and analytics solutions.
* Collaborate with client and technical teams to integrate Workiva with ERP, HR, Identity Management, and other enterprise systems.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including user story refinement, effort estimation, and sprint planning.
* Conduct requirements workshops, solution demonstrations, showback sessions, UAT support, and knowledge transfer sessions.
* Perform testing, quality assurance, and defect resolution activities.
* Provide technical and functional guidance to project teams and mentor junior resources.
* Stay current with Workiva platform enhancements, GRC trends, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.
* Assist regional teams in RFP responses, solution proposals, effort estimations, and client presentations.
* Develop and maintain productive client relationships and contribute to customer success.
* Ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks while adhering to project quality standards and organizational policies.
* Support project leadership in planning, estimation, delivery governance, and stakeholder management activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and workshop facilitation skills.
* Ability to translate complex risk and compliance requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience creating solution design documents, process flows, and implementation artifacts.
* Ability to work effectively within cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a strong quality culture.
* Ability to mentor team members and support capability-building initiatives.

**To qualify for the role, you must have-**

* 3 to 8+ years of relevant experience in GRC, Internal Audit, Risk Management, Compliance, or Governance Technology implementations.
* Experience working on 3 to 5 end-to-end Workiva implementation engagements.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
* Workiva Internal Controls Management (SOX)
* Workiva Risk Management
* Workiva Internal Audit Management
* Workiva Compliance Programs
* ESG Reporting
* Regulatory Reporting
* Strong understanding of:
* SOX Compliance
* Internal Controls Frameworks
* Enterprise Risk Management
* Internal Audit Processes
* Regulatory Compliance
* Information Security Governance
* Experience facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, configuring solutions, and supporting UAT.
* Experience creating and maintaining functional and technical documentation.
* Working knowledge of reporting, dashboarding, workflow design, and data management within Workiva.
* Experience in client-facing consulting engagements and stakeholder management.

**Ideally, you should also have**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional certifications such as:

- CPA
- CIA
- CISA
- CRISC
- Workiva Certifications

* Experience with large-scale transformation or compliance programs.
* Understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
* Experience working with consulting firms, system integrators, or Big 4 organizations.
* Exposure to enterprise platforms such as:

- AuditBoard
- Archer
- ServiceNow IRM
- MetricStream
- Diligent HighBond
- SAP GRC

* Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools such as:

- Power BI
- Tableau
- Alteryx
- Snowflake

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Demonstrated these skills at an expert level:

title: Graduate
description:
**Job Description**
The Graduate Professional will join one of WSP India's multidisciplinary engineering, planning or architectural teams. The role provides an opportunity to apply postgraduate knowledge to live project work while developing technical, digital, commercial, and professional capabilities under the guidance of experienced colleagues.
  
  
The exact discipline, team, project portfolio, reporting line, and location will be confirmed through the relevant requisition and offer documentation. Responsibilities will be aligned to the candidate's Master's specialization and the validated requirements of the receiving business team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Assist in the delivery of discipline-specific project tasks under appropriate technical supervision.
* Prepare calculations, analyses, drawings, models, schedules, reports, presentations, and other project deliverables relevant to the assigned discipline.
* Apply applicable codes, standards, client requirements and WSP quality procedures, with guidance from senior team members.
* Use relevant digital tools and software to produce accurate, coordinated, and traceable outputs.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary colleagues and contribute constructively to design reviews, project meetings, and technical discussions.
* Undertake research, data collection, site or context analysis, option assessment, and technical documentation as required by the assignment.
* Check personal work for accuracy, completeness and compliance before submission for review.
* Manage allocated tasks responsibly, communicate progress and risks early, and meet agreed quality and delivery expectations.
* Maintain project records and support document control, information management, and knowledge-sharing requirements.
* Participate actively in learning, mentoring, feedback, and professional development activities.
* Follow WSP requirements relating to health, safety, wellbeing, ethics, information security and responsible business conduct.

**Discipline-specific contribution areas**
****Discipline cluster****
****Illustrative contribution areas****
**Engineering**
Technical analysis and design support; calculations and modelling; drawings and specifications; design coordination; asset, infrastructure or systems assessments; technical reports and quality checks.
  
  
**Planning**
Spatial and policy research; evidence and data analysis; development, infrastructure, transport or environmental planning support; stakeholder material; options appraisal; mapping and report preparation.
  
  
**Architecture**
Design development; drawings, schedules and presentations; BIM or digital model support; material and precedent research; multidisciplinary design coordination; documentation across project stages.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A completed or completed master's degree from a recognized institution in a discipline relevant to the assigned role. A master's degree is mandatory for this requisition.
* Relevant academic specialization aligned to the business requirement stated in the individual requisition.
* Sound academic understanding of the principles, methods and tools applicable to the chosen discipline.
* Ability to communicate professionally in written and spoken English.
* Eligibility to work in India and willingness to work from the location stated in the offer and requisition.

**Preferred Academic Backgrounds**

* The specific qualification must be stated in each requisition. Relevant postgraduate disciplines may include, but are not limited to:
* Engineering: Structural, Civil, Geotechnical, Transportation, Water, Environmental, Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services, Energy, Sustainability or another role-aligned engineering specialization.
* Planning: Urban and Regional Planning, Transport Planning, Infrastructure Planning, Environmental Planning, Housing, Town and Country Planning or another relevant planning specialization.
* Architecture and built environment: Architecture, Urban Design, Landscape Architecture, Sustainable Architecture, Building Information Modelling or another role-aligned specialization.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**Who We Are:**
Lifecycle service engineers.
  
  
Lifecycle services for DCS are comprehensive support offerings designed to ensure the long-term performance, reliability, and safety of automation systems throughout their operational life. Here's a summary of what these services typically include, using Emerson's DeltaV DCS.
  
  
For This Role, You Will Need:
  
  

* Technical: Team member and self-directed contributor. Works well within a team but is equally capable of performing independently.

* Knowledge of Pharma / Chemical Industry / Refinery is an added advantage.

Possesses a strong general knowledge base and is developing expertise in a specific service area. Holds or is pursuing relevant certifications and continues to build skills within the identified product and certification domain.

Apprentice – Assistant Project Manager

1 October 2026

  
  
  
  

**About Pearson**

  
  

Pearson is the world’s leading learning company, dedicated to helping people make progress in their lives through learning. Founded in 1844, we deliver digital-first, accessible learning experiences and employ over 20,000 people globally. In India, we support learners and educators through innovative educational products, technology, and services.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable workplace where every employee is valued and empowered to thrive.

  
  

**About the Apprenticeship Program**

  
  

Pearson India’s Apprenticeship Program provides graduates and early-career professionals with structured training, hands-on experience, and mentorship from industry experts. Through a blend of on-the-job learning and guided development, apprentices build the professional and technical skills needed to succeed in a global organization.

  
  

**About the Division**

  
  

The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager for the Higher Education International Division will help to ensure the assembly, execution, and maintenance of major products according to specified objectives—budget, schedule, and adherence to quality standards. The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager is part of the broader team that executes annual plans and organizes and prioritizes tasks and teams to ensure delivery.

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

You will work with authors, Pearson Content and Digital Producers, Quality Assurance (QA), Accessibility, Rights and Permissions (R&P) and vendor partners to deliver stable, high‐quality products to improve learner outcomes and maximize instructor impact. You will also manage production schedules for print and digital assets. This role is ideal for a fresher or early-career professional who is eager to learn project management, risk assessment and mitigation, and digital product creation in the higher education space.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  
* Content production of selected print, digital, and supplemental content.
  
  
* Production of digital courseware content that will be used in both print and digital delivery.
  
  
* Maintain legacy data on a vast number of series-specific titles, including print books and editorial supplements, while at the same time helping to guide the list through the transition to a nextGen digital format.
  
  
* Learn how to act as point-person throughout entire lifecycle process, respond to queries from various stakeholders, serve as knowledge resource for Portfolio team.
  
  
* Learn how to provide high-level management of a large number of primary authors, development editors, technical editors, supplement authors, copyeditors, and freelance project managers. Negotiate rates, prioritize work.
  
  
* Learn how to provide communication across cross-functional teams. Includes initiating launch meetings, serving as meeting moderator, and maintaining status reports.a
  
  
* Coordinating and keeping track of budgets in all the projects
  
  
* Learn to drive creation of project schedules; enforce adherence; provide accountability charter for delays.
  
  
* Serve as liaison with Rights and Permission team; ensure quality of coverage; escalate any schedule delays or budget concerns.
  
  
* Identify and manage vendors to schedule, budget, and quality compliance; provide feedback on performance.
  
  
* Enforce system maintenance and data integrity of records; oversee invoice processing and reconciliation.
  
  
* Support in contributing to cover and internal design process.
  

  

**Desirable Skills and Attributes**

  

  
* Highly flexible and adaptable, with a positive attitude when operating in an environment of continual flux.
  
  
* Ability to think and act independently to seek out resolutions and problem-solve on a daily basis.
  
  
* Ability to influence and negotiate where necessary with peers, project team, sponsors/stakeholders, and other internal teams as needed.
  
  
* Ability to respond confidently to conflicts and manage situations positively, proactively escalating ongoing issues and showing solid judgment.
  
  
* Demonstrates highly active ownership of projects, possesses ability to proactively assess and mitigate risk, and actively poses solutions to problems.
  
  
* Communicates effectively (written and verbally) with peers, project team, and sponsors/stakeholders. Shows strong command of the English language.
  
  
* Able to assess and manage across a full project breadth and depth, ensuring a successful delivery of products.
  
  
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams delivering both digital and print product outputs.
  
  
* Diligent attention to detail.
  
  
* Strong organization skills: Self-organizing and self-motivating.
  
  
* Strong time-management abilities--organizing tasks in a logical and efficient manner allowing for multitasking and making appropriate calls on prioritization.
  

  

**Eligibility Criteria**

  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
  
  
* Recent graduates or candidates with less than one to three years of experience are encouraged to apply.
  
  
* Must meet requirements under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and be registered on the NATS portal.
  
  
* Must be legally eligible to work in India.
  

  

**Experience You Will Gain**

  

  
* Practical exposure to Project Management operations, scheduling and budgeting.
  
  
* Hands-on experience in risk assessment and mitigation, and professional communication.
  
  
* Experience in creating and sharing schedules using Smartsheets.
  
  
* Understanding of how digital learning products are built and created.
  
  
* Opportunity to work with Product, Content Solutions, QA, and R&P teams in a professional business environment.
  

  

**Work Schedule**

  
  

This is a full-time apprenticeship from Monday to Friday, approximately 40 hours per week. The role involves working across several geographies and requires occasional flexibility in supporting the business beyond regular office hours.

  
  

**Benefits and Rewards**

  

  
* Competitive stipend
  
  
* Professional development and mentorship
  
  
* Paid time off as per company policy
  
  
* Personal Accident Insurance Coverage
  

  

Access to Pearson’s learning platforms and online courses

  

  
* Exposure to global work culture and career pathways
  

  

**Location**

  
  

This role will be based at Pearson's office in Noida.

  
  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

  
  

Pearson India is committed to building an inclusive environment that embraces diverse perspectives and backgrounds. We value equality, respect, and belonging, ensuring every employee has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

  
  

**Application Closing Date:**

  
  

This position is offered under the Apprentices Act, 1961, as part of an official Apprenticeship Program. As an apprentice, you will undergo structured on-the-job training, combined with theoretical learning where applicable, to develop specific skills and prepare for skilled employment.

  
  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

  
  

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. title: Engineer - Customer Project Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Own the project control activity and drive consistent functional specifications and common global processes for projects implementation. Activities that are conducted to better understand or ultimately meet the expectations of the customer Accountable for the quality of own work. Subject to direct operations supervision/prescribed work instructions/systems checking. Executes within a well-defined operations framework. There is generally a step-by-step sequence of standard operational tasks which need to be followed to achieve an end result.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
As a Excitation Systems Engineer, you will support the design, testing, and field support of excitation control systems for synchronous generators. This is an ideal role for an early-career engineer looking to develop deep technical expertise in power plant control systems, working closely with experienced engineers to ensure reliable system engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Engineering Support: Assist in the preparation of electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications for excitation cubicles low to high rating generators of Hydro, Steam, Gas plants etc.
* Control Logic: Participate in the review and modification of control software logic (function blocks and ladder logic) under the guidance of senior staff.
* Testing & Validation: Support factory acceptance testing (FAT) and assist with site commissioning, including checking field wiring and performing signal loop checks.
* Coordination: Participate to technical discussion with customers and vendors and Participate to engineering Optimization, Standardization & Simplification efforts & Establish tools, template & processes to enable faster turnaround and improve productivity.
* Documentation: Maintain project technical files, update "as-built" documentation, and assist in drafting technical reports for clients.
* Problem-Solving: Help troubleshoot minor control system issues by analyzing alarm logs and event records from the excitation controller.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Experience: 1–2 years of professional experience in an electrical engineering role (internships and co-ops will be considered).
* Technical Skills:

+ Foundational knowledge of power systems and rotating machinery (synchronous generators).
+ Proficiency with CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, EPLAN) for electrical schematics.
+ Basic understanding of control theory and feedback systems.
+ Ability to read and interpret electrical wiring diagrams and logic flowcharts.

* Soft Skills: High attention to detail, eagerness to learn complex control systems, and strong verbal and written communication skills.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Knowledge of different electrical codes / standards for designing the excitation system & elsewise.
* Knowledge of engineering tools e.g., AutoCAD, E3 for electrical design, Inventor for Mechanical design etc.
* Exposure to industrial control systems (PLCs, DCS, or specific excitation controller platforms).
* Basic programming skills or experience with simulation software (MATLAB/Simulink).
* Willingness to travel to power plant sites for commissioning support (typically 10–25% travel).

title: Assistant CAD Technician - Roads
description:
**Responsibilities**

* Create detailed engineering drawings for Extra High Voltage (EHV) projects, covering both Air Insulated Substations (AIS) and Gas Insulated Substations (GIS), ranging from 11kV up to 400kV (with a particular emphasis on 132kV voltages and above)
* Preparation and development of EC&I deliverables such as Single Line Diagrams, loop drawings, cable block diagrams, plant layouts, cable routing, cable containment design and switchgear configurations using both 2D and 3D software packages;
* Develop darwings to support detailed engineering, such as Land Utilisation Plan, Elevations, Above and Below Grade Conduit layouts, Grounding layout & it’s connection details, Lighting and Lightning protection with respective details, Bill of Materials, CDM, MEWP layouts.
* Facilitate coordination of design activities across various departments, including Civil/Structural, Networks, and Transmission Line. Conduct design reviews, participate in virtual meetings, and collaborate closely with clients.
* Assist with preparing drawings and revising existing engineering drawings of basic components from specific sketches or layouts.
* Responsible for adhering to company and client drafting standards and procedures.
* Responsible for adhering to the drafting practices of selected discipline.
* Coordinate with team members and monitor project schedules, ensuring submissions meet high-quality standards.
* Maintain compliance to CDM Regulations and all other legal and regulatory requirements associated with the nature of substation and electrical system design.
* Collaborate with WSP UK office on design activities.
* Develop and enhance processes, tools, and potentially implement new technologies into the design process.
* Periodic Quality check to be conducted for other engineers & designers.
* Exhibit ingenuity, foresight, and wise decision-making skills in proactively identifying and resolving challenges.
* Contribute to the progress and growth of departmental tools and workflows aimed at improving the effectiveness of design processes, specification development, and project implementation.
* Experience on working in Raster image files.
* Preferably familiar with UK projects. Experience of working in a lead substation design role on National Grid Electricity Transmission projects (or other UK utilities like SSEN, SPEN etc.) in the UK will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Onshore wind, Offshore wind, Renewable (solar) and BESS projects is preferred.
* Familiarity with 3D tools (Revit) for Engineering design is desirable.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge and experience in Microsoft Office programs, including, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Self-motivated and eager learner, aptitude to grow and develop within the field.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma in Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline.

BGV:
  
  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
**Our Hybrid Working Module**
With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
  
  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
  
  
**Inclusivity and Diversity**
WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
  
  
**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
  
  
**With us, you can.
  
  
Apply today.**
**NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:**
*WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.*

description:

Drive technology innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology drives the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, where smart tech and AI are seamlessly woven into daily life. From self-driving cars and health-monitoring smartwatches to renewable energy systems that efficiently distribute clean power, Synopsys creates high-performance silicon chips that help build a healthier, safer, and more sustainable world.

title: Technical Editor
description:
**Reporting to - Head of Publishing Operations**

**About Packt**

Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals. We are a technical publisher and learning provider with over 400 staff based across the globe, primarily in India and the UK. Our products have global relevance, and our multimedia portfolio includes over 7,000 books, e-books, audiobooks, and video courses.

For more details, visit www.packtpub.com.

**Role Overview**

As a technical editor, you will work in partnership with content creators and editors to create high-quality products on time, according to the publishing plan. You own the product’s technical accuracy, working with the content creator and other internal stakeholders from the delivery of the first draft of the content to publication. The TE is an editorial quality-control role. The goal of editorial is to raise the revenue performance of every product by understanding content creator and user needs and the market we're publishing into.

The role is ideal for methodical thinkers who can carry out efficient and purposeful code testing, using excellent technical skills. You will adopt an advisory role with content creators, using firm and diplomatic communication to help them understand the technical concerns that you have. This will lead to accurate technical content that allows readers to easily learn about new technologies and develop new skills.

The TE will, in addition to the above, work on different product types to ensure they all meet the standards expected by our customers. These product types may be derived products, such as an audiobook or course based on a book. They may be new products created through market and user research.

This demands a strong focus on quality from TEs: you will understand the level of quality our customers expect and own this on your products. To do this you will have to seek customer feedback throughout the editorial process and apply this during your testing. It is vital you keep track of new tech releases and user trends.

**What You Will Do**

**Technical:**

* Ensure technical accuracy of the content: test all code in the product, as well as all code in the code bundle, ensuring they match
* Follow along with all examples and steps in the product
* Address any other technical concerns you find in the book (technical facts, references, screenshots, architecture, approach, and so on)
* Ensure code indentation is accurate and that the code remains consistent throughout the content
* Verify content coverage thoroughly to ensure technical accuracy
* Perform quality checks on code-related Amazon reviews, errata, and GitHub issues
* Manage book repositories on GitHub and resolve any reader queries alongside the customer care team
* Support the team to improve code repositories and code-testing systems
* Research technology innovations to deepen your tech. knowledge in your vertical’s topic area
* Connect to users and research to deepen your knowledge of users in your vertical’s topic area
* Keep up with market changes that could impact the delivery or success of a product, for example, tech. version updates and competing titles

**Editorial:**

* Function as a reader advocate for your book from a technical point of view
* Query the author if any part of the code isn’t clear
* Provide a technical health check for the portfolio director to facilitate accurate planning and time allocation
* Carry out user research and market analysis to elevate your work
* Work with technical reviewers to ensure technical accuracy of the content and code. Use this to build up an understanding of the book and its audience
* Own the technical quality of a product: sign off the technical aspects of a product for production; advise on whether a product is suitable for cancellation
* Navigate the optimum balance of quality and timeliness in dialog with the rest of the product team
* Apply the Packt styles to the content and ensure the formatting follows the Packt style sheet

**Author/Expert management:**

* Provide detailed and constructive feedback to content creators using the appropriate tone to suggest the necessary actions that will ensure that the technical content matches the proposition and meets Packt’s quality standards
* Build positive yet challenging relationships to get the most from content creators

**Who You Are**

You are a logical, efficient technical editor with a strong passion for creating high-quality, technical content. You possess a good understanding of technology and are skilled at code testing. You work collaboratively with authors, editors, and technical reviewers, balancing high standards with commercial and product goals. You thrive in dynamic environments and continuously seek to optimize processes and workflows to deliver exceptional content.

**Must-have skills:**

* Technology testing: good working knowledge of at least one technology to the level that you can test code and examples in that domain area
* Quality assurance: rigorous attention to detail with a proven track record of ensuring content quality, accuracy, and consistency
* Technical content understanding: strong ability to interpret and convey complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences
* Research: the ability to get up to speed on an unfamiliar technology so you can test and evaluate technical content in that topic
* Author relationship management: the ability to build relationships with authors, providing constructive feedback and ensuring their vision is realized
* Stakeholder communication: good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders

**Good-to-have skills:**

* Process optimization: ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements in quality-control processes and workflows
* Adaptability: ability to adapt quickly to changing requirements and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced environments

**Why Work at Packt**

We are a global and remote-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We are a fun place to work but with a focus on performance and personal development providing opportunities for personal growth and career progression. We try to achieve this by:

* Ensuring a positive working environment for all team members, supportive of flexible and remote work.
* Supporting individual development through growth opportunities and internal mobility.
* Encouraging social collaboration within teams and communities and knowledge-sharing.
* Fostering a culture that supports a healthy work-life balance.

We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by:

* Providing a broad range of benefits and initiatives.
* Advocating a healthy lifestyle where wellbeing is seen as an essential responsibility.
* Celebrating success stories and encouraging peer-to-peer recognition.
* Fostering a culture of self-development.
* Providing a work environment where the best idea wins, and challenges are encouraged.

**Benefits:**

You will also have access to a range of flexible benefits that are designed to help you make the most of your time with us.

Bonus scheme

5 day working week

25 days annual holiday (plus bank holidays)

Flexible hours: choose how, when, and where you work within India

Training programs and Certification

Group Medical Insurance

Wellness initiatives

**Salary Range - INR 25 - 40K fixed pay per month (skills and/or experience dependent)**

**Disclaimer: Packt does not authorize any third-party consultancies, influencers, or agencies to offer employment opportunities on our behalf. We are not involved in any financial transactions with these parties. Our hiring process is managed internally, and all applications should be made through the official procedures outlined in our job listings.**

title: Founder's Office - Operations Lead
description:
Founder's Office – Operations Lead

Location: Noida (on-site, 6 days a week) · Experience: 5–8 years · Reports to: CEO / Founders

**The role:**

SiteRecon is hiring an Operations Lead in the Founder's Office. You will work directly with the founders to find the problems that slow our business down, design practical solutions, and put them into practice on the ground, across a mapping operation of 120+ cartographers serving customers in the US and Canada.

This is not an advisory role. You will spot a problem in the data or on the floor, work out the fix, get Team Leads, Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Sales behind it, roll it out, and prove with numbers that it worked. Then you will move to the next one.

This role suits someone who thinks like a problem-solver, executes like an operator, and knows how to bring people along through change.

About SiteRecon

SiteRecon helps property-maintenance contractors in North America map properties and plan site visits in minutes, so they win more bids and run more profitable jobs. We were founded by IIT Delhi alumni with backgrounds in satellite imaging, e-commerce and edtech.

Learn more: https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

**What you'll do:**

Find the problems that matter

* Dig into operations data, customer escalations and floor-level workflows to find what is hurting delivery, quality, cost or customer experience.
* Separate symptoms from root causes, size each problem by business impact, and agree priorities with the founders.
* Track the metrics that show where operations are slipping: productivity, TAT, SLA adherence, rework, backlog and capacity.

**Design and implement solutions**

* Turn each problem into a clear solution with an owner, a plan, a timeline and a success metric.
* Pilot changes with one team or shift, measure the results, and scale what works across the operation.
* Redesign SOPs, quality checks, workflows and team structures where needed, and make sure they hold on the floor after launch.

**Lead technology and process change**

* Work with Product and Engineering to define tool and workflow improvements for mapping and QA, and own their rollout to the floor.
* Identify manual, repetitive work that can be automated or simplified, and drive it through to implementation.
* Make sure operations can absorb significant growth in volume without the same growth in headcount or complexity.

**Drive change management**

* Win buy-in from Team Leads, QA Supervisors and cartographers for new ways of working, and handle resistance with clarity and patience.
* Plan communication, training and handholding for every change so adoption sticks across shifts.
* Align Customer Success, Sales and the CEO on changes that affect customers, delivery timelines or capacity.

**Track and report improvements**

* Build a simple tracker of every initiative: baseline, target, current result and owner.
* Set up daily, weekly and monthly dashboards that show the impact of changes on operational KPIs.
* Run regular reviews with the founders on what has improved, what has stalled, and what comes next.

Support the founders

title: Sr Principal Product Engineer
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**

Cadence is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality. With the integration of ChipStack, we are redefining the industry by bringing agentic AI capabilities directly into the silicon development lifecycle. title: BIM Content Creator
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
Role purpose
  
  
The MIC BIM Component Creator develops, tests, documents and maintains intelligent, reusable, data-rich BIM content for the Moata Intelligent Content (MIC) library. The role converts engineering and project requirements into reliable digital components that enable standardized, efficient and automated design delivery across infrastructure and building projects.
  
  
Working with MIC curators, content checkers, approvers, publishers and project teams, the role ensures that content is technically accurate, lightweight, interoperable, correctly classified and ready for controlled publication and reuse.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  

* Develop and maintain parametric, data-rich BIM content, including Revit families, AutoCAD-based components, Civil 3D subassemblies and other platform-specific assets required by MIC.
* Interpret briefs, engineering requirements, manufacturer information and project standards, then convert them into clear content specifications and fit-for-purpose digital components.
* Apply MIC naming, classification, parameter, metadata, category, subcategory and documentation standards consistently throughout the content lifecycle.
* Build content that is efficient in file size, stable in use, visually appropriate, correctly constrained and suitable for reuse in large project models.
* Configure and test geometry, parameters, formulas, types, visibility settings, connectors, materials and data outputs, as applicable to the authoring platform.
* Create and test Civil 3D subassemblies using Subassembly Composer, including parameters, targets, conditions, codes and corridor behavior where required.
* Complete self-checks and peer checks before content is submitted through the MIC review, approval, versioning and publication gateways.
* Respond to checker and approver feedback, correct identified issues and maintain traceable records of revisions, testing and status.
* Maintain content documentation, thumbnails, reference files, metadata, version information and progress updates in the relevant MIC tracking and catalogue systems.
* Collaborate with project teams, engineering specialists and digital delivery stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve technical issues and support content adoption.
* Provide practical support to users, investigate content-related issues and implement controlled updates without compromising existing use cases.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for standardization, batch processing, automation, quality assurance and reusable workflows.
* Share knowledge with colleagues and develop capabilities across relevant Autodesk, Bentley, GIS, data and automation platforms.

**Essential Qualifications And Experience**

* HNC/HND, diploma, degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, architecture, construction technology, information technology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrable experience creating, editing and quality-checking BIM or digital engineering content within at least one engineering discipline.
* Strong knowledge of BIM content-development principles, including parametric modelling, data structures, classification, naming, performance optimization and quality assurance.
* Proficiency in Revit family creation, including parameters, formulas, nested content, categories, subcategories, visibility controls, materials and testing.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD and Civil 3D; hands-on experience with Civil 3D Subassembly Composer is required for roles supporting corridor content.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, schedules, manufacturer data and project requirements.
* Experience working within controlled review, approval, version-management and publication processes.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and locations.

Desirable knowledge and experience
  

* Experience with Bentley platforms, including MicroStation, OpenBuildings Designer, DGN and CEL content.
* Working knowledge of GIS platforms such as Esri ArcGIS.
* Experience with content catalogues or repositories such as Bentley Component Center and Autodesk Content Catalogue.
* Knowledge of shared-parameter management, data integration, batch processing or tools such as DiRoots.
* Exposure to scripting or automation for BIM content creation and quality assurance, such as Dynamo, Python or platform APIs.
* Experience developing generic or manufacturer content for the Water, Wastewater, Transport, Energy or Built Environment sectors.

Technical quality expectations
  
  
**Quality area**
**Expected outcome**
**Functionality**
Content behaves predictably across the intended types, views, levels of detail and project conditions.
  
  
**Data quality**
Parameters, metadata, classifications and units are complete, accurate, consistent and usable.
  
  
**Performance**
Geometry and file size are proportionate to purpose and do not create avoidable model-performance issues.
  
  
**Standards**
Naming, categories, subcategories, materials, documentation and catalogue information follow current MIC requirements.
  
  
**Verification**
Content is tested, warnings and redundant elements are resolved, and evidence is available for review.
  
  
**Lifecycle control**
Revisions, dependencies, references, status and publication information are recorded and traceable.
  
  
Personal attributes and behaviors
  

* Quality-focused, methodical and attentive to detail.
* Curious about technology and willing to build capability across multiple authoring and data platforms.
* Collaborative and respectful, with a strong commitment to shared team outcomes.
* Proactive in planning work, raising risks, solving problems and following tasks through to completion.
* Comfortable receiving, applying and providing constructive technical feedback.
* Committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing and an automation-first mindset.

Measures of success
  

* Components meet agreed requirements and pass MIC checking and approval with minimal avoidable rework.
* Deliverables are completed to the agreed scope, quality and schedule, with progress and risks communicated clearly.
* Published content is reusable, discoverable, correctly documented and supported through its lifecycle.
* Feedback from users and reviewers is converted into measurable improvements to content and working practices.
* This role contributes to stronger standards, automation, platform capability and knowledge sharing across the MIC team.

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

**Employment Compliance Requirement**
As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
By applying, you
**confirm**
that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

title: Technical/Product Publications, Sr Engineer
description:
**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
A technical writer with experience in turning complex technical information into documentation that people actually read, not just files that sit in a repository.
  
  
You have worked in DITA XML, you understand topics and maps, and you know why content reuse saves more than just time. When a product manager/SME hands you half-formed specs and a developer gives you a code comment as context, you do not wait for perfection. You ask the right questions, dig into the product yourself, and build something clear from the pieces you have.
  
  
You are detail-oriented and can review documents for consistency and catch the terminology drift that everyone else missed. At Synopsys, you will work on customer-facing documentation for products that power semiconductor development worldwide, and what you write will directly affect how engineers understand and use those tools.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Create and maintain customer documentation using DITA XML in Adobe FrameMaker or Oxygen XML, structuring content for reuse, modularity, and multi-format publishing
* Work directly with developers, product managers, QA engineers, and SMEs to collect technical information, validate accuracy, and drive documentation reviews through to sign-off
* Analyze product functionality and translate it into task-based, user-focused documentation that helps engineers solve real problems
* Review and edit documentation for technical accuracy, grammar, terminology consistency, and adherence to Synopsys style guidelines
* Manage documentation updates aligned with product release schedules, ensuring content is versioned, tracked, and delivered on time
* Create and maintain supporting content such as screenshots, diagrams, workflows, tables, and illustrations.
* Identify gaps and inconsistencies in existing documentation and contribute to process improvements, templates, and authoring standards

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to adopt and use Synopsys EDA and IP products more effectively through clear, accurate documentation
* Reduce support escalations by ensuring engineers can find answers in the docs instead of filing tickets
* Improve documentation consistency and reusability across product lines, making updates faster and reducing duplication
* Accelerate product launches by delivering documentation that meets release milestones without blocking engineering timelines
* Strengthen the quality bar for technical content across the organization by contributing to standards, templates, and peer reviews
* Help shape how Synopsys leverages structured authoring and emerging tools like AI to scale documentation efforts
* Build documentation that holds up under real-world use, not just passes internal review

**What You'll Need**

* 2 to 4 years of professional experience in technical writing, ideally for software or technology products
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent discipline
* Hands-on experience with DITA XML concepts including topics, maps, content reuse, conditional content, and cross-references
* Proficiency in Adobe FrameMaker or Oxygen XML for structured authoring and publishing
* Strong command of technical communication fundamentals like task-based writing, information architecture, and content structuring
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git or Perforce for managing documentation source files
* Experience with MS Visio for creating technical diagrams and process flows is a plus, as is exposure to AI tools for content drafting, summarization, or quality improvement

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a design review with engineers, absorb the technical details, and walk out with a plan for how to document it clearly for three different user personas
* You manage multiple documentation projects and deadlines without missing release dates
* You push back when technical information is incomplete or when a proposed change will confuse users, and you do it in a way that keeps the collaboration moving
* You work independently across time zones and distributed teams, but you also know when to pull people into a review or escalate a blocker
* You care about the details, catching terminology inconsistencies, broken links, and formatting issues that others miss, but you also ship on time
* You are curious about new tools and workflows, whether that means exploring AI-assisted authoring, automation scripts, or better ways to structure content for reuse

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
  
  
**Rewards And Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process

* Strong communication, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams.

* Automotive, industrial manufacturing, electromechanical, or precision engineering environments.
* High-volume assembly and automated production lines.
* Continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and operational excellence initiatives.

title: Curriculum Manager (STEAM Education)
description:
**About NASCA**

NASCA is one of India’s premier educational content research organisations, widely recognised for its pioneering work in STEM / STEAM education and skill development programmes across leading schools and institutions in India. Our mission is to integrate cutting-edge technology education into school curricula and empower students with future-ready 21st-century skills in areas such as Electronics, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Design Thinking, and other industry-relevant domains. Our programmes align fully with the
**National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**
and the
**ATL Mission**
. We are also a privileged content collaborator with the
**International Baccalaureate Organization (Geneva)**
and  
**World Academy of Career Programmes (Singapore)**

**World STEM Federation (US).**

**Job Description: Sr. Manager - STEM Curriculum**

**Position Type:**
Full-time (On-site)

**Location:**
Noida, India

**Educational Qualifications**

* PhD. / M.Tech in Electronics, Robotics, or Mechatronics (Top-tier institutions preferred)
* Strong academic background

**Working knowledge of:**

* Tools & Platforms: Python, ARDUINO IDE, SAS, MATLAB and AI tools
* Programming Languages: HTML, Java, SQL, C++

**Job Role**

* Lead and manage a team of faculty members to ensure the effective implementation of NASCA’s STEAM programme curriculum across all partner institutions. Provide academic guidance, monitor performance, and ensure consistent delivery standards aligned with NASCA’s educational vision and pedagogical framework.

* Candidate will be required to conceptualize and draft Science & Technology curriculum in form of ‘Application based’ projects that seeks to acquaint students on various aspects of STEAM Education (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts & Mathematics).

* Scope of the curriculum will include developing ‘Foundation’, ‘Preliminary’, ‘Intermediate’ and ‘Advance’ levels of Physics, Mechanics, Robotics, Electronics, Coding and Programming, IOT, Artificial Intelligence and Design Thinking Modules for a spectrum of students ranging from Jr Kg to Grade 12.

* Ensure the curriculum adopts an interdisciplinary framework, promoting the natural convergence of Science, Technology, and Mathematics in problem-solving and project execution.

* Develop and document comprehensive lesson plans, project manuals, and instructional presentations (audio-visual content) to support teachers and students through each module.

* Conduct regular training and orientation sessions for NASCA faculty and implementation teams to ensure consistent and high-quality curriculum delivery.

* Present curriculum designs, updates, and pedagogical innovations at academic management meetings, client schools, and business development sessions as required.

* Mentor faculties and students on Domestic and International Robotic competitions and Olympiads

**Professional Experience**

* Minimum 3-4 years of teaching experience in technology education

* Team player with excellent interpersonal and people management skills
* Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities
* High analytical thinking and quick information processing
* Adaptable, with the ability to multitask across dynamic priorities
* Passionate, disciplined, and professionally committed to high work standards
* Ability to simplify technical concepts based on student age and learning level
* Strong belief in inquiry-driven and hands-on pedagogy

**Ready to Inspire Young Innovators?**

If you are enthusiastic about transforming education and mentoring the next generation of STEM leaders, send us your updated CV and a recent photograph at
**careers@nasca.edu.in**

title: Solution Cost Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova is seeking a Solution Cost Manager to join our HVDC team. This role is responsible for managing the cost baselines for all the HVDC reference solutions to ensure a concise, accurate and competitive cost basis is available and can be applied consistently across regions and tenders/projects. The Solution Cost Manager sits at the intersection of solution strategy, sourcing excellence, design improvement and cost competitiveness.
  
  
**Job Description**
The successful candidate will own the cost framework and baseline of each reference solution that will serve as the templates for individual bids as well as the basis for analysis and decision making as each reference solution is developed. This manager will drive the use of these cost baselines, support bid and execution teams in the correct application while coordinating contributors from various fields (NPI, Value Proposition, Sourcing, etc). A special focus shall be given on improving competitiveness, controlling risk, and protecting profitability.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Own and develop reference solution cost baselines, templates and deployment packages, ensuring the baselines are clearly defined, accurate, user-friendly and well maintained.
* Drive the use of these cost baselines and ensure they are readily available and accessible to all users and stakeholders
* Define, maintain, and govern standard cost baselines for end-to-end reference solutions
* Work with Global Sourcing and others to keep costs up-to-date, identify any gaps and obtain costings as needed
* Operate in close coordination with the OTR cost controllers to understand actual costs from projects and use this information to refine the reference solution cost baselines
* Work with Proposal Managers to ensure that ITOC models are used correctly and efficiency
* Participate in the tender review process to support, review and ensure the consistency of the data presented
* Support bid and project teams during tender and execution phases by ensuring the correct cost baselines are used in line with intended standards and assumptions
* Coordinate Solution Line and Regional stakeholders involved in sourcing, finance and cost control ensuring alignment between processes and regional business needs
* Provide cost input for analysis and decision making associated with the development of the existing reference solutions and the establishment of new solutions as needed
* Identify, assess, and mitigate cost-related risks early in the lifecycle to improve execution readiness, reduce delivery uncertainty, and protect profitability
* Continuously evolve the reference solution cost baselines based on market needs, lessons learned, tendering and execution feedback, and business priorities
* Contribute to improving win rate, execution consistency, and margin performance by strengthening the quality, competitiveness, and use of reference solutions

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Project Management, or related field
* Demonstrated experience in cost analysis, bid management, proposal management or Finance in an engineering and/or project environment
* Proven experience developing, governing, or deploying standardized cost tools and references or reusable frameworks in a multi-project or multi-region environment
* Strong understanding of project cost control processes and industry-standard methodologies
* Experience with cost analysis tools and the ability to develop specific tools as needed to support the work
* Demonstrated ability to drive use of standardized tools and references and process improvement across cross-functional teams
* Stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, tendering, regional, commercial teams
* Proven ability to identify risks, resolve cross-functional issues, and drive alignment in complex business environments
* Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in power systems, grid solutions, power conversion technologies, or other industrial infrastructure businesses
* Experience working in global organizations with regional execution models
* Familiarity with bid management, project execution, and lifecycle support processes
* Experience defining cost models, lead time assumptions, standard terms, or deployment methodologies for standard solutions
* Experience driving continuous improvement, lessons learned, and return-on-experience integration into standard offerings

* Familiar with documentation control platforms such as Aconex, Autodesk, ProjectWise.

description:

title: SPA/Programme Lead- Clean Energy
company: International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST)
description:
**Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate, Clean Energy**

The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST) is inviting applications for the positions of Programme Lead and Senior Programme Associate under its Clean Energy Programme.

We are looking for experienced, motivated professionals with a strong understanding of India’s renewable energy sector, demonstrated analytical and research capabilities, and a proven track record in programme execution, advisory and implementation-oriented assignments. The role also requires excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder engagement skills to support high-impact clean energy transition initiatives across states and sectors.

https://forms.gle/Bujd7qyMMpFB2vFY8

Required Experience for
**Programme Lead**
: 10+ years

Required Experience for
**Senior Programme Associate**
: 5–7 years

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Reporting to: Director, Clean Energy (Programme Lead) / Programme Lead, Clean Energy (Senior Programme Associate)

**About iFOREST**

iFOREST is an independent, not-for-profit research and innovation organisation established in 2019. Our mission is to identify, promote and scale up solutions for critical environment-development challenges in India and other developing regions across Asia and Africa.

We focus on regional priorities to accelerate environmental action at the sub-national level, while influencing national policies and plans to support these efforts. By drawing on our resources and expertise, we aim to address regional needs, strengthen national action and contribute to global solutions.

Our work involves independent, evidence-based research, developing innovative solutions, convening stakeholders to build consensus, and partnering with think tanks, civil society organisations, government agencies, philanthropies and industry leaders.

**The Clean Energy Programme**

The iFOREST Clean Energy Programme focuses on accelerating equitable renewable energy growth in India by supporting clean energy deployment in underserved states, especially in the eastern and northeastern regions.

The programme supports state governments through policy and regulatory reform, implementation strategies, techno-economic assessments, investment facilitation and institutional capacity building. Its focus states include Odisha, Assam, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh. The work prioritises land-neutral technologies such as floating solar, agri-PV, rooftop solar, storage and green hydrogen.

**The Role**

The Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate will drive research, policy advisory and implementation activities under the Clean Energy Programme. The Programme Lead will anchor delivery of the programme, working closely with the Director across research, engagement, technical support and implementation, and will manage teams and workstreams. The Senior Programme Associate will lead the execution of key assignments, particularly on industrial renewable energy adoption, demand aggregation and investment mobilisation in Uttar Pradesh and other priority states.

The selected candidates will work closely with state governments, renewable energy agencies, utilities, industrial associations, MSMEs, development partners and other stakeholders to develop and implement renewable energy transition initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive execution of ongoing and planned projects, ensuring timely delivery of committed activities, outputs, milestones and reporting requirements
* Design and manage workplans, research methodologies, analytical frameworks and implementation strategies for programme assignments
* Conduct and oversee primary and secondary research, techno-economic assessments and policy analysis on industrial RE adoption, RE procurement, demand aggregation and storage integration
* Lead preparation of research reports, policy briefs, technical outputs, regulatory recommendations and investment-oriented strategies, with analytical rigour and quality control
* Support the design and operationalisation of RE demand aggregation initiatives and pilot projects in industrial clusters
* Build and maintain strong relationships with government agencies, utilities, industries, MSMEs, research institutions, CSOs, media and development partners
* Lead stakeholder consultations, workshops, trainings, convenings and field engagements
* Represent iFOREST in external meetings, consultations, conferences and sectoral discussions
* Contribute to programme development, including concept notes, technical proposals, budgets, pitch materials and partnership building
* Manage and mentor programme teams, supporting work allocation, progress tracking and capacity building (Programme Lead)
* Undertake any additional responsibilities related to the advancement of the Clean Energy Programme and institutional priorities

**Qualification & Work Experience**

At least a master’s degree from a recognised institution in a relevant field, such as energy policy, public policy, economics, management, renewable energy, engineering or a related discipline.

Around 10 years of relevant experience for the Programme Lead, and 5–7 years for the Senior Programme Associate, in research, strategy consulting, advisory, programme implementation or policy engagement focused on the renewable energy sector.

A demonstrated track record of producing high-quality research and advisory outputs, such as reports, briefs, assessments, presentations and implementation frameworks.

Experience of working with government agencies, utilities, industries, industry associations, development partners or research institutions will be an advantage.

**Required Competencies**

* Strong understanding of India’s renewable energy sector, including its policies, regulations, programmes, technologies, industrial markets, open access, captive energy and implementation challenges
* Proven experience in qualitative and quantitative research, policy analysis and techno-economic assessments
* Strong programme execution and project management capabilities
* Ability to engage effectively with government, industry, research institutions, CSOs and development partners
* Strong analytical, writing, presentation, communication and problem-solving skills
* Collaborative, proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with strong organisational and time-management skills
* Experience in proposal development, programme reporting and donor coordination is desirable
* Willingness to travel as required

**What We Offer**

At iFOREST, we provide an inclusive and supportive work environment. We are committed to professional development through education, training and capacity-building initiatives.

* Opportunity to contribute to high-impact clean energy transition and renewable energy deployment initiatives across India
* Exposure to policy processes, government engagement and technical advisory work
* A dynamic and supportive work culture that values methodological rigour and innovation
* Competitive compensation in line with experience and organisational norms

**Remuneration**

We offer a competitive salary based on experience and proficiency. The final designation will depend on the qualifications and experience of the selected candidate.

**Application Instructions**

We prefer that candidates apply through LinkedIn https://forms.gle/Bujd7qyMMpFB2vFY8 or submit an online application at https://iforest.global/careers/
